title: Pagination
description: x-pagination builds Previous/Next and numbered page links inside a <nav> from total and perPage (or an explicit pages), marks current as active, and fires wb:pagination:change when another page is chosen.

total.description: Total number of items. With `perPage` this derives the page count.

pages.description: Explicit page count. Overrides the count derived from `total`/`perPage`.

current.description: Active page, counting from **1**. Defaults to `1`.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
